caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher positioned upright at the center of a plain beige background. The pitcher is transparent with a clear glass body and an elegantly curved handle attached at the top and side. Its wide, bulbous lower body curves inward at the neck and flares outward again at the spout, which is prominent and rounded for pouring. The pitcher is decorated with swirling pink lines that follow the curves of the glass from the base up to the rim, forming an intricate, repetitive pattern. The base of the pitcher is circular and flat, rendered in shades of gray to indicate its transparency and reflective qualities. The objects in the drawing consist only of the pitcher, with no additional items or background elements present. In the lower right corner, the artist’s name appears, handwritten. There is also a small measurement scale drawn below the pitcher toward the left side.
title: Cream Pitcher
